函数 $y=\frac{12}{x}$ 在整个定义域上是减函数，那就错了. 实际上，取 $x_1=-2$，$x_2=6$，从不等式 $x_2>x_1$ 并不能得出：
$\frac{12}{x_2}<\frac{12}{x_1}$（因为 $\frac{12}{x_2}=\frac{12}{6}=2$，$\frac{12}{x_1}=\frac{12}{-2}=-6$）.这样一来，对于我们指出的一对自变量的值来说，“自变量较大的值对应的函数值也较小”这个条件不成立.
errata.reason: For the specified pair x1=-2<x2=6, f(x1)=-6<f(x2)=2. The larger-input/larger-output comparison is true, whereas the decreasing comparison is false. Replace only the last comparison word 较大 with 较小, keeping 不成立 and every formula/value, to preserve the counterexample to whole-domain decrease. Equivalent editorial alternatives do not create mathematical-intent ambiguity. For real nonzero x the printed relation implies x^2=-6, so it has no real graph; x=0 is undefined. The task asks for function graphs and monotonic intervals and uses y as output in its companion and parallel tasks. Keeping the printed right-hand expression -6/x, the uniquely supported minimal semantic repair is y=-6/x. An alternative x=-6/y yields the identical graph, not a competing mathematical intent.
